description: Work-in-progress static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Switch, v1.9.0) for Windows and Linux. Bring your own dump: no game files, keys or dumping tools included.

latest_release.name: Savage Wind Alpha 6 (0.6.0-alpha.6)
latest_release.body:
**Savage Wind Alpha 6: the upscaler update.**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of the game, updated to **version 1.9.0**
> (and the DLC, version 3.0, if you want it), extracted from **your own** Nintendo Switch. Savage Wind provides no game
> files, keys, firmware, dumping or decryption tools, or instructions to obtain any of them, and it never decrypts
> anything. The game code is recompiled on your machine, from your files, for your own use only: don't share it.
> Respect the copyright laws of your country. This is a fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

## Downloads

| File | For | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `SavageWind-0.6.0-alpha.6-windows.zip` | Windows 10 or later, x86-64 | Supported |
| `Savage_Wind-0.6.0-alpha.6-x86_64.AppImage` | Linux x86-64 with glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36, Arch, SteamOS...) | Supported |
| `Savage_Wind-0.6.0-alpha.6-aarch64.AppImage` | Linux on ARM64 with a Vulkan 1.3 driver | **Highly experimental** |

The `.sig` files next to them are what Savage Wind checks before it installs an update: you don't need them.

## Updating to Alpha 6

**From 0.5.1, 0.5.2 or 0.5.3:** Savage Wind Configuration offers it: press **Update**. On the first start the game code
is built again for this version (a few minutes). Your game files, saves and settings stay.

**From 0.5.0 or older:** by hand, once: extract the zip over your old folder (Windows), or use the new AppImage (Linux).

**NVIDIA DLSS:** Savage Wind doesn't ship NVIDIA's library. Savage Wind Configuration downloads it from NVIDIA's own
repository on your PC. Without internet, copy `nvngx_dlss.dll` next to `savagewind.exe`.

### Upscalers and graphics

- **NVIDIA DLSS** in Video > Upscaler, on RTX graphics cards on Windows ([#602](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/pull/602) by Yiozolm). Savage Wind doesn't
  ship NVIDIA's library: Savage Wind Configuration downloads it from NVIDIA's own repository on your PC (offline:
  copy `nvngx_dlss.dll` next to `savagewind.exe`). RTX 20 and 30 cards get DLSS's CNN model and RTX 40 and later its
  transformer model: left to NVIDIA's choice, the transformer cost an RTX 3060 more than DLSS saved. RTX 3060, 4K,
  Savage preset at 100%: 94 fps without an upscaler, 123 with DLSS Performance. `SAVAGEWIND_DLSS_PRESET=<n>` picks
  another model.
- **Native mode** for FSR 3 and FSR 4: their anti-aliasing at the window's resolution ([#820](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/pull/820) by jfpaardoo).
- **Render scale** changes only the 3D scene: the HUD and menus stay sharp at any scale, and above 100% the menus no
  longer shrink inside black bands ([#835](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/pull/835) by jfpaardoo, [#764](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/764), [#746](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/746)).
- **HDR options** have a page of their own under Video > Advanced options, with a RenoDX extended tone mapper,
  PsychoV, live presets and an Advanced fold ([#572](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/pull/572) by EthanBlazkowicz).
- **Ultrawide:** the pause menu, the loading screen and the start screen keep their 16:9 layout ([#805](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/805)).
- **Gerudo Desert terrain** no longer comes out as huge spikes or dark patches around Molduga and Molduking
  ([#855](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/855), [#872](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/872), [#797](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/797), [#816](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/816)).
- **Waterfall bases** on GPUs without attachment feedback loops (older NVIDIA, Intel, older AMD) ([#848](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/848), [#868](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/pull/868)
  by jfpaardoo).
- **Frame generation while riding:** the horse and the Mast

detail.readme:
Download · Get started · Status · FAQ · Issues · Changelog

**Savage Wind Recomp** is a work-in-progress static recompilation of *The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild* (Nintendo Switch, version 1.9.0) into a native application for Windows and Linux, built from your own copy of the game.

Screenshots taken in Savage Wind. The game is © Nintendo; you need your own copy to run it.

> [!IMPORTANT] > **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of the game, updated to **version 1.9.0** > and dumped from **your own** Nintendo Switch. This project does not provide game files, keys, firmware, dumping or > decryption tools, or instructions on how to obtain them. The game code is recompiled locally, on your machine, > from your files. > [!NOTE] > **Made almost entirely with AI.** Nearly all of the code, tooling, reverse engineering and documentation is written > by an AI (Anthropic's Claude, through Claude Code), directed, tested and reviewed by a human. It builds on > [LAS Recomp](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp), made the same way. If you don't trust code written by AI, you > can simply ignore this project. > [!WARNING] > **This is an alpha.** The whole game can be finished from start to end, and as of Alpha 6 no known bug stops you > from progressing, but expect bugs and crashes in some places, and some mechanics that break above 30 fps > ([#425](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/425)). If a cutscene freezes or breaks, lower the frame > rate to 30 fps for that scene. > > **Please read the [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md) before asking** about game file formats, mod support or testing. Many great > contributors help out, but every review, approval and release test is done by one person with limited hardware. > > **Alpha 7 will take longer than usual:** development slows down a bit while GTA VI comes out. Game-breaking bugs > still get quick fixes first, and bug reports and pull requests stay welcome. We're still on track for the **Beta > within the next month**, which will focus on full mod support and more quality-of-life options. ## Features - The whole game and both DLC, from your own copy - Frame rates from 30 to 360 fps, or your display's own rate - Resolutions up to 4K and beyond, and ultrawide - Upscaling with NVIDIA DLSS, AMD FSR 3, FSR 4 and FSR 1, and FSR 3 frame generation - Graphics presets from Potato, below console quality, to Savage, far beyond it - Longer draw distance, sharper shadows, adjustable field of view, colour grading and HDR - Keyboard and mouse with real mouse camera, and any controller, gyro included (Steam Input, DSU servers, handhelds) - Button prompts that match your device - Save profiles, backups, a custom save folder, and Wii U / Cemu save import - Steam Deck and PC handhelds, and Add to Steam - One-click updates from Savage Wind Configuration - Photo mode, colour vision filters, accessibility options, cheats and a teleport ([Cheats and assists](docs/cheats-and-assists.md)) - Discord Rich Presence (off by default) ## Get started **You need:** your own game files (see [Game files](docs/game-files.md)), Windows 10 or later or Linux on x86-64, a GPU with Vulkan 1.3, 16 GB of RAM, a CPU with SSE4.2 (AVX2 runs faster) and about 20 GB of free disk space. 1. Download the latest build from [Releases](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/releases/latest): - **Windows:** the file ending in `windows.zip`. Extract it to a folder you can write to, not Program Files. - **Linux and Steam Deck:** the file ending in `x86_64.AppImage`. Make it executable and run it ([docs/linux.md](docs/linux.md)). - **Linux on ARM:** the file ending in `aarch64.AppImage`. It is highly experimental. 2. Start it and choose the folder with your extracted game (`exefs/` and `romfs/`). Then choose **Set up game files**. It checks the version, copies the files and recompiles the game code once, about 15 minutes on a 12-thread CPU. Your own files aren't changed. 3. Play. Settings and languages are in the game's Options. **Savage Wind Configuration** has your game files and the rest of the settings. **Updating:** from version 0.5.1 on, Savage Wind Configuration updates it in one click, on Windows and in the Linux AppImages. Before that, extract the new zip over the old folder or use the new AppImage. Your game files, saves and settings stay. Something wrong? See the [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md), which also lists the known issues. ## Saves Saves are in the `save` folder of Savage Wind's data folder: next to `savagewind.exe` on Windows, and in `~/.local/share/savagewind/save/` on Linux and the Steam Deck. To back them up or move them, close the game and copy the whole folder. More in [Saves](docs/saves.md), including profiles and Wii U / Cemu import. ## Cheats, assists and amiibo Colour vision for colour-blind players, god mode, infinite stamina, damage and weapon wear settings, items, rupees, weather, teleporting and the virtual amiibo reader: how to use them in [Cheats and assists](docs/cheats-and-assists.md). ## Status | Area | Share | Progress | |---|---|---| | Core game | 45% | ![Core game](docs/media/progress/area-core-game.svg) | | Platforms and input | 15% | ![Platforms and input](docs/media/progress/area-platforms-and-input.svg) | | Performance | 15% | ![Performance](docs/media/progress/area-performance.svg) | | Graphics options | 12% | ![Graphics options](docs/media/progress/area-graphics-options.svg) | | Player features | 13% | ![Player features](docs/media/progress/area-player-features.svg) | Every part, what it means and how the average is calculated: [Status](docs/STATUS.md). ## Controls Any controller SDL knows works. Keyboard and mouse defaults: | Action | Key | Action | Key | |---|---|---|---| | Move | W A S D | Camera | Mouse | | Jump | Space | Sprint / back | Left Shift | | Interact | E | Attack | Left click | | Shield | Right click | Bow | F | | Rune | Q | Throw | R | | Inventory | Tab | Map | M | Every action can be rebound in the game's Options. All the keys: [Controls](docs/controls.md). ## Found a bug? Read the [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md) first: issues about something it already covers are closed right away. Use the latest release and game version 1.9.0, search the [existing issues](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues?q=is%3Aissue), and [open one](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/issues/new/choose) with your `savagewind.log`. On a crash or a cutscene bug, attach your zipped `save` folder too. Reports without these are closed after 24 hours. ## Contributing and building Open pull requests against the [`test`](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp/tree/test) branch, which has everything ahead of the latest release. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). To build from source: [Windows](docs/BUILD-windows.md) and [Linux](docs/linux.md). ## Respect copyright - *The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild* is © Nintendo. This is a fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Nintendo. *Nintendo Switch* and *The Legend of Zelda* are trademarks of Nintendo. - This repository contains no game files, no game code (also not the C code the recompiler generates from it), no assets, no fonts, no keys - and release builds won't either. - The game code you generate and the build made from it contain Nintendo's code. They are for your own use only: don't share them, upload them or ship them. - Issues, pull requests or discussions that contain game files, keys, generated code or links to pirated copies will be removed. Piracy is not supported in any way. - Follow the copyright laws of your country. Dumping a game you own for personal use is legal in some countries and not in others; that is your responsibility. ## Credits and license Built on **[LAS Recomp](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp)** by peiikai (MIT), with [TotK Recomp](https://github.com/valentderah/totk-pc-recomp) by Valiantsin Dzerakh (MIT) and [Ryujinx](https://github.com/Ryujinx/Ryujinx) (MIT) as references. Full list and the licenses of what releases bundle: [Credits](docs/third-party.md). Savage Wind Recomp's own code is under the [MIT License](LICENSE). The license covers this project's code only: it grants nothing for Nintendo's game, which you must supply yourself.
